reviewed_by: Codex scoped Butler mobile table review
reason: Butler renders Core-saved Markdown replies in a narrow panel. The component tests cover transcript interaction, eight selected assistant popup browser cases cover table readability, local horizontal scrolling, and reload across desktop Chromium and six mobile Chromium/WebKit widths, and one disposable LAN Core WebKit case verifies the durable message path.
exclusions: No Python, native, provider, harness, or unrelated UI tests: only the Butler reply renderer and CSS change. Full suites are excluded. Physical iPhone testing remains an operator acceptance gate.
